hypotheses.rationale: Keys out early morning suggests commute; phone on sofa at midday suggests lunch break or remote work; phone at nightstand suggests standard sleep routine.
Keys out at 05:28 could be returning from night shift; phone on sofa at 14:25 could be waking up; phone at nightstand at 21:11 could be going to sleep before day shift.
Keys out at 05:28 could be for a morning gym session; however, lack of sports gear evidence makes this less likely than standard work.
